_comment: Copy to mcp.config.json and set PATCHPILOT_MCP_ENABLED=true.
Discovery is not permission. Tools found on these servers are registered
and then filtered by PATCHPILOT_TOOL_ALLOW / PATCHPILOT_TOOL_DENY, so a
newly discovered tool is unreachable until an operator allows it by name.
